caseName: First Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n v. Hulm
caseNameFull: FIRST FEDERAL SAVINGS AND LOAN ASSOCIATION OF BISMARCK v. Theodore George HULM, aka Ted Hulm and Tom A. Brigham

opinions.text: The motion of respondent Theodore George Hulm for leave to proceed in forma pauperis is granted. The motion of respondent Tom A. Brigham for leave to proceed in forma pauperis is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.
